items: kit catalogue sheet, batch 2a, at phone size

requests.ask: KitSkin.piece: on parchment grounds, look up the tertiary's `button_tertiary__parchment__<state>` (the violet box fails value-steps on paper)
requests.default: screens put no tertiary button on parchment until K1 wires the parchment shape

requests.ask: Move the colours in art/ui/palette.json's `kit` section (pressed, disabled, high-contrast and lifted-locked faces) into client/ui/tokens.json
requests.default: they stay in art/ui/kit_build/build_kit.py's KIT table and palette.json's `kit` section, each with where it comes from

requests.ask: art/ui/palette.json is written by art/ui/kit_build/build_kit.py until the bake makes it from tokens.json (kit-spec.md section 6.2; tools/ui_bake/README.md 'Not yet')
requests.default: build_kit.py keeps writing it; rerun it after any tokens.json change

requests.ask: Atlas capacity: batch 1a's 28 pieces fill 2048 x 1268 of the kit's 2048 atlas at 6 px/pt, so the rest of the kit will not fit one atlas
requests.default: the bake gains atlas pages (kit.webp, kit_2.webp, ...) before batch 1b; AIA keeps the piece sizes

requests.ask: Batch 1b fills the kit atlas: 51 pieces in 2048 x ~1900, and disc_school's 6 pieces do not fit beside them. When the bake gains atlas pages (AIA-R12), bake art/ui/kit_next/disc_school/ into the kit; KitSkin draws disc_school as its tinted `box` (vertex-coloured per school) under the untinted `frame` (ink, gloss, outline), both at the same rect
requests.default: disc_school stays in art/ui/kit_next/ (sources written, proofed from SVG, not baked) and draws in code until the atlas has pages; no piece is shrunk

requests.ask: Batch 1b adds overlay skins KitSkin.SKINS lacks: `selected` (selected__rim, drawn over a card for card_selected), `spinner` (spinner__ring, rotated in code), and pieces `locked__lock`, `badge__dot`, `bar_track__tick`, `disc__level_disc`, `tag__tag_violet`, `tag__tag_warn`, `bar_fill__alarm`; bar_fill__box is a neutral tinted per use (data-tint), so its gold variant is dropped; tag_success falls back to tag__box
requests.default: the pieces sit in the atlas unused; every batch 1b skin stays off in kit_families.json and draws in code

requests.ask: Batch 1c bakes the numerals as num_<finish>_<glyph> (finishes gold 28, white 22, timer 28, timer_red 28 pt; glyphs 0-9, comma, period, colon, slash, plus, minus, percent, x, question, space) on atlas page 2, drawn in Manrope 800 with tabular figures per §21.8 and D4 (b). (1) kit-spec.md section 2.2's T3 row still says the baked numerals are drawn with Lilita One: please make it read Manrope 800 tabular. (2) To draw them, KitSkin sets a number glyph by glyph: each piece carries `advance`; the piece's box is its advance cell plus 1 pt each side, so draw it at pen - (w - advance)/2 and move the pen by `advance`. The client's own number formatting picks the separators (en 1,234 / 12.5; pt_br 1.234 / 12,5)
requests.default: the numerals stay Manrope 800 tabular; the pieces sit in the atlas unused and numbers draw as code-drawn text until KitSkin sets them

requests.ask: Batch 2a adds pieces KitSkin must draw: (1) `ribbon__box` is a neutral tinted per school (data-tint) and `ribbon__frame` (untinted gloss and ink) is drawn over it at the same rect, as disc_school; `ribbon__chapter` is the untinted violet chapter ribbon; the words sit on the band, the top 32 pt of the 42 pt piece. (2) The grab handles `sheet__handle` and `sheet__handle_parchment` are 42 x 9 pt sprites centred by code 12 pt below a sheet's top edge (a 9-slice cannot centre them). (3) `frame_<rank>__box__<state>` is a 9-slice ring with a hollow middle, drawn over the portrait's rect grown by 4 pt each side. (4) `popup__box` carries an 8/4/12 pt margin round its face (plus the 5 pt lip) and is drawn over the scrim; its title is a ribbon set across the top edge. (5) `header__name_plate` is the header's leather plate; `panel_parchment__parchment_done` is the done panel with its green seal in the top-right corner cell
requests.default: the pieces sit in the atlas unused; those skins stay off in kit_families.json and draw in code
